projects.title: Moisture Detection Platform
projects.description: - An app and device integration that I created to help detect and prevent Urinary Incontinence in the elderly and excessive sweat loss that could result in a coma for diabetic patients. - I created the device using a microcontroller and electrical accessories in order to make a cost efficient moisture detecting sensor that is connected to an app on the phone alerting the caregiver of any of these problems.- I started this passion project after being in one of India’s hospitals and seeing the amount of elderly people in hospitals going through this problem because of no low cost solution (“About 1 in every 3 men and women in America suffer from some form of Urinary incontinence”)
